release_rule: Every success and error path frees or transfers all four arguments before returning.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: A successful onig_new handle is released exactly once with onig_free after search completion; compile failure returns before ownership is acquired.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: onig_region_new creates it, intermediate nonempty global matches clear region contents without freeing the handle, and final cleanup frees the handle and contents.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: The length-delimited bytes are borrowed only during onig_new; regex remains live until compilation returns.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: Oniguruma borrows length-delimited input bytes for each synchronous search; no pointer may escape f_match or outlive input.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: jq copies matched bytes and scalar offsets before the next region clear or final free.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: The callback copies name bytes into jv storage and retains no foreign pointer or group array.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: onig_error_code_to_str writes at most ONIG_MAX_ERROR_MESSAGE_LEN and jq copies it into an owned jv string before return.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: Successful return transfers the boolean or array; a search error frees the partial array before replacing it with an invalid message.
author: codex-specialty-regex

release_rule: Array/object setters and append operations transfer constructed values into the final result; the result tree owns their copied strings.
author: codex-specialty-regex
